description: Returns Shprd's published statement of what it holds: the essentials of the Christian faith it affirms with the Nicene Creed, and the list of matters where faithful Christians differ and Shprd presents each view. Use this when the user asks what Shprd believes, what Shprd's position or statement of faith is, or how Shprd handles a question of doctrine. It is Shprd's own statement, not Bible text and not a ruling on any tradition. It does not read or search the Bible.
name: get_shprd_beliefs
title: What Shprd holds
